subject: general
question: ______ refers to an environment in which oxygen is readily available.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aerobic.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aerobic refers to an environment in which oxygen is readily available.**
 
• Aerobic respiration is the process of cellular respiration to produce energy from food in the presence of oxygen.
 
• This respiration is common in most plants and animals, humans, other mammals, and birds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anaerobic **respiration is a process without the use of oxygen. 
 
• **Anthropogenic **activities are also known as man-made activities. It involves processes that are intentional and harmful. 
 
• **Acidification **describes the process by which the addition of nitrogen (N) decreases soil pH, which can have a variety of direct and indirect effects on plant growth.
